name: MonarchCodeSnippetTabs
title: CodeSnippetTabs
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.SecondaryScrollableTabRow and androidx.compose.material3.Tab over MonarchCodeBlock, with android.content.SharedPreferences for the synced choice
summary: The same code example in several languages or tools, one tab each, with a copy button, optionally kept on the reader's language across every set that shares a sync key.
whenToUse: In developer documentation or an API settings screen, to show one request in cURL, Kotlin, Swift and other languages.
whenNotToUse: For one snippet use MonarchCodeBlock. For tabs that switch between different content use the Material 3 tab rows (Tabs).
api: @Composable public fun MonarchCodeSnippetTabs(snippets: List<MonarchCodeSnippet>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, label: String? = null, selection: String? = null, onSelectionChange: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, syncKey: String? = null, showLineNumbers: Boolean = false, onCopy: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, codeBlockLabels: MonarchCodeBlockLabels = MonarchCodeBlockLabels())
public class MonarchCodeSnippet(label: String, code: String, language: String? = null, id: String? = null, title: String? = null) { val id: String }

options.name: snippets
options.description: The same example in each language, in tab order. A snippet's id defaults to its label; repeated ids are left out.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the tabs and the code.

options.name: label
options.description: The spoken name of the tab row. Built in: Language.

options.name: selection
options.description: The id of the snippet to show, when the app controls it. An id with no snippet falls back to the synced or own choice, then the first snippet.

options.name: onSelectionChange
options.description: Called with the id of the snippet the reader chose.

options.name: syncKey
options.description: Keeps every set with this key on the same language and remembers it in SharedPreferences (file monarch_code_snippet_tabs, key monarch.codeSnippetTabs.<key>).

options.name: showLineNumbers
options.description: Whether the code shows line numbers.

options.name: onCopy
options.description: Called with the copied code after each copy.

options.name: codeBlockLabels
options.description: Replacements for the code block's built-in strings (Copy, Copied, Wrap, …).

states.name: several snippets
states.description: The tab row and the selected snippet's code block.

states.name: one snippet
states.description: Only the code block, without tabs.

states.name: synced
states.description: Choosing a tab in one set switches every set on screen with the same syncKey that has that snippet, and the choice is restored on the next launch.

appearance: The Material 3 secondary tab row in the theme's Material colors (the selected tab and its line in the accent), over the MonarchCodeBlock surface with its code type. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow the theme.
platformNotes: The web keeps the synced choice in localStorage and notifies the other sets on the page; on Android the choice is snapshot state shared in the process, so every set on screen follows it, and it is written to SharedPreferences, so it survives a restart (iOS uses UserDefaults; DataStore is not a Monarch dependency). The iOS variant parameter (a line or a pill) is not offered: Material 3 has one tab row for this, and SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow does not scroll with many languages. iOS takes a selection binding; Android takes selection with onSelectionChange.
accessibility: The tab row is named Language (or label); each tab has the tab role and the selected state.
The code block is MonarchCodeBlock: named after its title or language, with a copy button that announces the copy.
Tabs have 48dp touch targets, scroll sideways when they do not fit and keep their text whole at font scale 2.0; they mirror in right-to-left layouts.
Code reads left to right in right-to-left layouts, as in MonarchCodeBlock.
edgeCases: A stored choice that a set has no snippet for is ignored by that set, which keeps its own choice.
Two snippets with the same label need distinct ids.
Changing tabs replaces the code block, so its wrap toggle resets.

examples.title: Request in three languages
examples.template:
MonarchCodeSnippetTabs(
    snippets = listOf(
        MonarchCodeSnippet({{snippets.0.label}}, code = {{snippets.0.code}}, language = {{snippets.0.language}}),
        MonarchCodeSnippet({{snippets.1.label}}, code = {{snippets.1.code}}, language = {{snippets.1.language}}),
        MonarchCodeSnippet({{snippets.2.label}}, code = {{snippets.2.code}}, language = {{snippets.2.language}}),
    ),
    label = {{label}},
)
examples.code:
MonarchCodeSnippetTabs(
    snippets = listOf(
        MonarchCodeSnippet("cURL", code = "curl https://api.example.com/v1/items \\\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer \$API_KEY\"", language = "bash"),
        MonarchCodeSnippet("JavaScript", code = "const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/v1/items', {\n  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer \${process.env.API_KEY}` },\n});", language = "js"),
        MonarchCodeSnippet("Python", code = "import os, requests\n\nrequests.get(\n    'https://api.example.com/v1/items',\n    headers={'Authorization': f\"Bearer {os.environ['API_KEY']}\"},\n)", language = "python"),
    ),
    label = "Request examples",
)

examples.title: A selection the app controls
examples.code:
MonarchCodeSnippetTabs(
    snippets = listOf(
        MonarchCodeSnippet("Kotlin", code = "println(1)", language = "kotlin", id = "kotlin"),
        MonarchCodeSnippet("Java", code = "System.out.println(1);", language = "java", id = "java"),
    ),
    selection = language,
    onSelectionChange = { language = it },
)
